items.title: A decade of mathematical certainty: Reflections on the Automated Reasoning Group
items.summary: In 2016 a small research team at Amazon announced our presence to the world with the launch of the Automated Reasoning Group (ARG). Our vision was bold: use mathematical logic to not just test AWS systems but to prove, with mathematical certainty, that they work correctly.
